Release storage nothing points to.

USAGE
  sennit reclaim [flags]

FLAGS
  --repack            Rewrite every live record into as few slabs as it fits in
                      before releasing the rest
  --orphans           Also release slabs the account is billed for that hold
                      nothing, including any stranded by an installation that
                      is gone
  --unreadable        Also delete objects the indexer holds but cannot open
  --take-ownership    Release storage this device hydrated rather than pinned;
                      only when the installation that wrote it is gone for
                      good, never when it is merely switched off
  --release-all       Release this vault's storage even though the catalog is
                      empty; only for a vault that really has been emptied,
                      never to work around a catalog that will not load

VAULT FLAGS
  --home dir          Vault directory (default ~/.sennit)
  --indexer url       Indexer URL (default https://sia.storage)
  --offline           Work from this device only, without contacting the
                      indexer

OUTPUT FLAGS
  --color when        When to colour output: auto, always or never (default
                      auto)
  --verbose           Show timings, read tiers and other detail

EXAMPLES
  $ sennit reclaim
  $ sennit reclaim --repack
